coordinate_scales: 1 m, 1 rad, 1 s; numerical normalization, not engineering limits
precision_input_contract: Exact frozen binary64 primitive geometry, angles, section/material scalars, IC, Vs and nominal loads. MPFR transcendental functions are enclosed, not replaced by stored outputs. Native binary64 pi and mathematical pi are reported separately for nominal loads.
exact_zero_rule: Exact rational zero or a symbolic proof; an interval overlapping zero is unresolved.
stop_conditions: interval denominator or branch unresolved at approved precision
